Required API: pub fn bounded_window_rollup(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse start,end,limit;timestamp=value records. Start, end, timestamps, and values are canonical signed decimals in -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807; limit is canonical unsigned decimal in 0..2147483647. Require start <= end. Select timestamps in [start,end), stable-sort by timestamp, retain the latest limit records, and return count:sum with signed-64-bit overflow rejection. Limit zero returns 0:0.
Visible example: 3,10,2;8=5,3=2,8=7,10=99 returns 2:12.

reference.code: fn sint(s:&str)->Option<i64>{if s=="0"{return Some(0)}let d=s.strip_prefix('-').unwrap_or(s);if d==s&&s.starts_with('+')||d.is_empty()||d.starts_with('0')||!d.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit()){return None}s.parse().ok()}pub fn bounded_window_rollup(input:&str)->Option<String>{let(h,b)=input.split_once(';')?;let a:Vec<_>=h.split(',').collect();if a.len()!=3{return None}let start=sint(a[0])?;let end=sint(a[1])?;if !a[2].bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit())||a[2].is_empty()||(a[2].len()>1&&a[2].starts_with('0')){return None}let limit:i32=a[2].parse().ok()?;if start>end{return None}let mut r=vec![];if !b.is_empty(){for(i,x)in b.split(',').enumerate(){let(t,v)=x.split_once('=')?;let(t,v)=(sint(t)?,sint(v)?);if t>=start&&t<end{r.push((t,i,v))}}}r.sort_by_key(|x|(x.0,x.1));let limit=limit as usize;if limit==0{r.clear()}else if r.len()>limit{r=r.split_off(r.len()-limit)}let sum=r.iter().try_fold(0i64,|q,x|q.checked_add(x.2))?;Some(format!("{}:{}",r.len(),sum))}
